verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-definable rules or event-triggered automation in Sketch. Prototyping hover/press triggers only simulate UI behavior in prototypes. Symbol propagation and starred-version Library updates are fixed built-in behaviors, not rules a user defines. The JavaScript plugin API and sketchtool CLI are developer building blocks, not a rules-and-triggers capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
